component.name: qimgv
component.summary: Fast and easy to use image viewer

description.p: GTK 3 rewrite of the qimgv image viewer with the same uncluttered interface and workflow.

ul.li: JPEG, PNG, APNG, GIF, WebP, JPEG XL, AVIF, HEIF/HEIC, camera RAW, BMP, TIFF, SVG and more
Animated GIF, APNG, WebP, JPEG XL and AVIF
Thumbnail panel and folder view with bookmarks
Quick copy / move to nine destination folders
